resources.string: Google asks this phone whether a sign-in is you. Nothing is approved without you.
Is it you trying to sign in?
Unlock your phone to review this Google sign-in request.
Tap the number shown on the sign-in screen
Approving needs Android 11 or later, which can ask for a fresh unlock. You can still answer No here, or approve on another device.
Set a screen lock to approve sign-ins on this phone.
Native prompt protocol not yet verified on device. Nothing was sent to Google.

Your answer may not have reached Google. Check the sign-in screen.
